title: Full-coupled projectable-ADM constraint identifiability preflight
question: Does the frozen s6fZ2 field-space gauge template by itself determine a unique full coupled ADM scalar constraint rank/DOF count, or is an independently selected gravitational ADM sector still required before a full-action embedding can be certified?

frozen_witness_class.scalar_sector: Exactly the s6fZ2 two-field action depending only on Phi=u1*phi+u2*chi; its local null redundancy is held fixed.
frozen_witness_class.gravity_family: S_g(lambda)=integral N sqrt(gamma) (M2/2)[K_ij K^ij - lambda K^2 + R^(3)] with projectable N=N(t).
frozen_witness_class.exact_identity: K_ij K^ij - lambda K^2 = Sigma_ij Sigma^ij + (1/3-lambda) K^2
frozen_witness_class.coefficient_policy: lambda is not fitted or selected; the two values are only an exact non-identifiability witness inside the otherwise-unfixed L_ADM slot of s6fZ2.

required_exact_checks: the s6fZ2 field-space null symmetry is unchanged throughout the gravity witness family
the trace-K kinetic coefficient is exactly 1/3-lambda
at lambda=1/3 the trace-K quadratic coefficient vanishes
at lambda=1 the trace-K quadratic coefficient is nonzero
therefore the gravitational kinetic/constraint structure is not fixed by the s6fZ2 scalar symmetry alone
no unique total scalar DOF count is claimed without choosing and fully reducing a gravitational sector

decision_rule.NON_IDENTIFIABLE_PASS_SCOPED: All exact witness checks pass, proving that s6fZ2 alone does not determine the full coupled ADM constraint rank/DOF count.
decision_rule.IDENTIFIABLE_PASS_SCOPED: A unique coupled constraint structure follows from the frozen parent without any extra gravitational-sector choice.
decision_rule.INCOMPLETE_BLOCKED_SCOPED: The frozen parent/target cannot be verified.

scope: Identifiability theorem only. A NON_IDENTIFIABLE result means the s6fZ2 symmetry template is insufficient to certify a full projectable RTK action; it is not a no-go for any independently specified gravitational completion.
